verdict.rationale: Airbyte ships an official open-source CLI, abctl, but the docs scope it to creating and managing local Airbyte instances in Docker, not to operating connections, syncs or connectors from the terminal. Programmatic control is otherwise offered through the API, the PyAirbyte Python library and the Terraform provider rather than a CLI. Missing for 10: a CLI covering connection/sync/connector management, AI- or agent-oriented CLI features (e.g. structured output for agents), and independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use.
